name: com.pinchasvaknin.arenaforge
description: Procedurally generates small competitive arena maps from a seed, a set of parameters and a layer of manual edits. Move a crate by hand, change a parameter, regenerate, and the crate stays where you put it. Includes a validation pass that measures sightlines, cover coverage, spawn fairness and connectivity, so a generated map can be judged rather than just looked at.

samples.description: A playfield, a free-fly camera and a catalog of primitive placeholder prefabs, with a map generated on play. Needs the Universal Render Pipeline and the Input System, which the tool itself does not.
